title: Ford Model T introduced
summary: Henry Ford introduced the Model T on 1 October 1908; it was built by hand at the Piquette Avenue plant in Detroit. Its price fell from about $850 in 1909 to $260 by 1924, and more than 15 million were built before production ended in May 1927.

uncertainty.note: Introduction on 1 October 1908 and end of production in May 1927 both come from the Detroit Historical Museum page; the Ford corporate page also gives May 1927 for the end.

as_recorded.value: In May 1927 a ceremony was held to honor the end of production
